Information

To access this page, you need an internet connection over the mobile network. Please disable Wi-Fi and re-access this page through the mobile-network.
If you are accessing the page using an Apple device and have Private Relay turned on, you will (also) have to deactivate this before accessing the page again. To deactivate Private Relay only once and temporarily, you can find further information here: https://support.apple.com/de- de/102022 (in German)

This service is free for you.
For questions, please contact customer service.
